In the [Broc Flower Cave](#loc=351678), [Vault 11](#loc=355579) and New Vegas Sewers, certain rat enemies will appear to be larger than usual and have their names changed to 'Rodent of Unusual Size'.

This is a reference to The Princess Bride, where a [Rodent of Unusual Size terrorizes Westley and Buttercup as they explore the Fire Swamp](https://youtu.be/Nv9CkjkOyzo?si=Jl-kii9R5XqMCcnd) - despite the former doubting that they exist. That line is also referenced when talking to [Lady Jane](#loc=513702).
511297:

The [Holy Frag Grenades](#loc=357389) and instructions written on a box ("Pull pin and count to ~~5~~ 3") are a reference to one used in [Monty Python and the Holy Grail.](https://youtu.be/xOrgLj9lOwk?si=Rwnkl4RWjvwelF8v)
511298:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait.

While killing trespassers, the Securitrons here will say 'Exterminate! Exterminate!', referencing the [Daleks from Doctor Who](https://youtu.be/mxD-5z_xHBU?si=hXBEuOwBi_Ck-viu), a genocidal race of aliens that effectively use it as a catchphrase whenever they're, well, exterminating.
511306:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

Replacing the regular corpse at the [Hilltop Stash](#loc=486171), Johnny is found dead among several props including four balls, five ace cards, and a pitcher.

These are references to Johnny Five-Aces, a character from Zybourne Clock. It was an ill-fated game idea accompanied by concept art presented to users on the Something Awful forums, where it was mocked and reached its ultimate fate as an inside joke.
511307:

511308:

On the northern wall of Cottonwood Cove HQ, you'll find graffiti reading 'Romanes Eunt Domus', roughly translating to 'People called Romanes, they go, the house'.

This references graffiti that gets Brian into trouble for its incorrect grammar in [Monty Python's Life of Brian.](https://youtu.be/IIAdHEwiAy8?si=F2W6r7X9z-qSYadd)
511923:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

This sequence of events references Lassie, a TV show from the 1950s that starred a dog often responsible for saving its young owner by getting the attention of adults. A similar scenario also appeared in a quest in Fallout 2.
511924:
**Note:** Only appears with the Wild Wasteland trait.

[Maud's Muggers](#loc=510052), a gang of vicious older women that attack as you leave [Cerulean Robotics](#loc=351669), are a reference to the [Hell's Grannies sketch](https://youtu.be/fvRgf5KK08U?si=1NVA21G4FZCmXgzm) from the 'Full Frontal Nudity' episode of the TV show Monty Python's Flying Circus.
511925:
**Note:** Only occurs with the Wild Wasteland trait.

This is a reference to a line in the Apple II version of Where in the U.S.A. Is Carmen Sandiego?, used whenever you were [close to finding a suspect.](https://youtu.be/zTHiPiERQGE?si=5sxYSp-IwZLVpx85&t=261)
511926:

Game over!'](https://youtu.be/oBB3C59Dzt0?si=iLBvTraJjBg_Tmiv) and ['They're coming out of the walls! They're coming out of the goddamn walls!'](https://youtu.be/DJQ_7jKIm24?si=1R7OQikWSbPuLzf4)
511928:

511929:
